topic: An AI-generated mock ad for the iPhone 18 Pro in the rumored Dark Cherry color is making people (including 9to5Mac's Zac Hall) actually like the color, days before Apple's Sept 9 event
details: Creator @kaye.creatives posted an Instagram Reel mock ad for iPhone 18 Pro in Dark Cherry, clearly labeled AI-generated. 9to5Mac's Zac Hall wrote about it 2026-09-06, saying he preferred Cosmic Orange but the AI ad sold him on Dark Cherry. Story angle: AI video generation is now good enough to do a phone's own marketing before the phone exists, and shift real opinion on an unreleased product's color. Sept 9 2026 Apple event ('Surprise and Shine') is 3 days out.
subject: An AI-generated mock ad for the iPhone 18 Pro in the rumored Dark Cherry color is making people (including 9to5Mac's Zac Hall) actually like the color, days before Apple's Sept 9 event
audience: iGeeksBlog's Apple/tech-news audience -- iPhone-curious viewers who already know 'Dark Cherry' is a rumored color and follow AI-video news casually.
core_value: A viewer sees that AI-generated marketing already changed a real tech editor's opinion on an unreleased Apple color, three days before Apple's own reveal.
desired_action: comment which color they're rooting for
tone: dry, skeptical, reporting register -- not hype, not warm. Wry about being 'sold' by AI, not alarmist about it.
footage_constraints: Credit @kaye.creatives (Instagram) on screen for any clip of their ad used. Attribute the Dark Cherry color/shade claims to reporting (leaker via Weibo, multiple outlets), never state it as our own claim or as confirmed. Nothing presented as confirmed until Apple's Sept 9 event.
